title: Wife's singing and the family's Catholic faith
summary: Wife's singing and church; family Catholic; joined the Masons then dropped out in the Depression; story on flowers and red beans.

story.theme_name: Church, faith and religion in a musician's life

blocks.x: Well I was going to ask, well I think I was having to think, does your wife still sing? I know she used to sing a lot of the spirituals and gospel things.
Oh she was probably nine then, since she'd been contacting with my sister back then. She never was about it, you know.
No, she ain't singing no church. Sometimes she'd get at church, you know, sing different things.
Which church did she go to?
Well she goes to Catholic Church now. Catholic Church now.
Was your family Catholic when you were young? Oh yeah, I was. You were all Catholic.
